book.title: Lijambu la Amboni ngati ejuandiki Matei

content: Kuyoka kwaka Yesu
Elapeta Lisoba lu Kupomulela, lisoba la juma pili pulukela ngani, Malia juku Magidala na Malia jongi jola bajenda kulinga litenge lela.
Apalapa sapitila kililima kikolongu pundema, ndaba ntumi jukunani waka Bambu jwatenda kuhuluka kuhuma kunani, juliingalitia lilibu lela pulutengu nukulitami panani.
Ntumi we jola jwang'ala ngati unang'anu ukitobi ni ingobu yaki yabia ihuu kupukupu.
Alonda bilitenge batenda kubagaja sulujogopu lukolongu, mbaka babia ngati atei kua.
Lakini ntumi jukunani jola jwaapwagila aka mbomba bala, “Mwee mwijogopa!” Japaga, “Nepani manyiki muntaputa Yesu jobumbambaliya pu nsalaba jola.
Ngasejubi pane, juyokiki ngati hejupwagike. Nhika nndingalia pandu pajwabii jugonile.
Henu, nzendania nyata mwakaapwagila banafunzi baki, ‘Yesu juyokiki kuhuma kwa bandu baa wile, na henu junndonguli ku Galilaya, mwaambona hakolakola.’ Nkombuka senumpwaji.”
Aka mbomba bala baboka ku litenge kola koni ajogopa ngamaa na mioju jabu jitweli ndogulela nukujombatake kwaapwagi banafunzi baki.
Apalapa, Yesu jwaketangana nabu nakwaapwagi, “Jambu oti.” Aka mbomba bala bunzendila, nukukamu magolu gaki nukungungamali.
Ndienu Yesu jwaapwagila, “Mwiijogopa! Nzendania mwakaapwagila alongu bangu ajendania ku Galilaya nakola biimona nepani.”
Alonda bilitenge apwaga sesapitila
Aka mbomba bala pababia atenda kuyetuana, aka alonda baakumu bilitenge bajenda ku musi kwaalandi agolu akolongu goti gagapitii kulitenge.
Ndienu, agolu akolongu baketangana pamu na aseja, ebajomula kulongalane bajetangania, baapekia alonda bilitenge bala lupija lwingi,
ndipala bapwaga, “Mwanganya mwiipwaga ana, ‘Banafunzi baki bahika kunziba ikilu, twepani twabii tugoni.’
Ana kilongosi ju ndema jumanyiki lijambu heli, twepani twiitenda kunkolo jujetakia, namwanganya ngamwikubi namang'aliku.”
Alonda bala bajukua lupija lola, batenda ngati hebaapwagila. Nilijambu heli laheni kwaka Ayaudi mbaka lelenu.
Yesu jwaapiti banafunzi baki
Banafunzi komi na jumu bala bajenda ku Galilaya kukitombi sejwaalagalakia Yesu ajenda.
Pabumbona Yesu batenda kungungamali, lakini bangi babu babiya ngaseanhobale.
Yesu jwahika pambipi jabu na kwaapwagi, “Ambekii uwesu woka kunani nu pundema.
Nzendania kwa bandu boti bupundema mwakaatenda bandu boti abia banafunzi bangu, mwakaabatisa kwiliina la Atati na laka Mwana na laka Loho jaka Sapanga,
mwaabola kukamu malagalaki goti ganundagalaki. Nanepani mi pamu na mwanganya masoba goha mbaka mwisu gu nndema.”
